description_en: Call CreateDbfs to create a pay-as-you-go Database File System (DBFS)
description_zh: 调用CreateDbfs创建一个按量付费的数据库文件系统
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs create-dbfs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --fs-name testdbfs-001 --category standard --size-g 200 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDbfs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, call DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database file system.

Valid values: 2 to 128 characters. The name must start with an English letter (case-sensitive) or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库文件系统名称。

取值范围：2~128个字符，以英文大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线和连字符（-）
parameters.name: fs_name

parameters.help_en:
The DBFS edition. Valid values:

standard: Standard Edition

enterprise: Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
数据库文件系统类型。取值范围：
standard：标准版
enterprise：企业版
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The capacity in GiB. If you specify this parameter, its value must be greater than or equal to the capacity of the specified snapshot.

Valid values: an integer from 20 to 32,768 if RAID0 data striping is disabled, or an integer from 160 to 262,144 if RAID0 data striping is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
容量大小，以GiB为单位。指定该参数后，其取值必须≥指定快照ID的容量大小。

取值范围：不使能RAID0条带化时为20-32768之间的整数；使能RAID0条带化时为160-262144之间的整数
parameters.name: size_g

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the DBFS instance
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: A client token used to ensure idempotence. Generate a unique value on your client for each request. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The snapshot ID used to create the DBFS instance
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete the source snapshot after creating the DBFS instance from it
parameters.help_zh: 使用快照创建DBFS后是否删除原始快照
parameters.name: delete_snapshot

parameters.help_en:
The performance level of the DBFS instance. Valid values:

PL0: Up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS per disk

PL1: Up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS per disk (default)

PL2: Up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS per disk

PL3: Up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS per disk
parameters.help_zh:
创建DBFS实例时，设置DBFS的性能等级。取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万

PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万（默认值）

PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万

PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万
parameters.name: performance_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create the DBFS instance using RAID.

Valid values: true or false. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否以RAID方式来创建DBFS。

取值范围：true或false，默认值为false
parameters.name: enable_raid

parameters.help_en:
The number of stripes. Required when EnableRaid is set to true.

Valid values: 2 to 8
parameters.help_zh:
条带数量。当EnableRaid参数为true时必传。

取值范围：2-8之间的整数
parameters.name: raid_stripe_unit_number

parameters.help_en: The KMS key ID used by the DBFS instance
parameters.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the DBFS instance.

Valid values: true or false. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否加密DBFS。

取值范围：true或false，默认值为false
parameters.name: encryption

parameters.help_en:
The use case for the DBFS instance. Valid values:

MySQL 5.7

PostgreSQL

MongoDB

Oracle RAC
parameters.help_zh:
DBFS的使用场景。取值范围：

MySQL 5.7

PostgreSQL

MongoDB

Oracle RAC
parameters.name: used_scene

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

dbfs.small

dbfs.medium

dbfs.large (default)
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。取值范围：

dbfs.small

dbfs.medium

dbfs.large（默认值）
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Customize CPU cores, memory limit, and PageCache size for the DBFS instance.

cpuCoreCount: Number of CPU cores.

memorySize: Memory size in MB.

pageCacheSize: PageCache size in MB
parameters.help_zh:
可定制数据库文件存储实例使用的CPU核数、内存上限值等。

cpuCoreCount：CPU核数。
memorySize：内存大小，单位MB。
pageCacheSize：PageCache缓存大小，单位MB
parameters.name: advanced_features

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authenticated principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The owner ID of the authenticated principal

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The type of the authenticated principal

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of permission that is missing
